{"kind":"effect-plugin","definition":{"id":"effect.affix.jinlong-discharged-impact","name":"卸振","kind":"affix","scope":"equipment","version":5,"description":"金笼焰击伤活敌并真正耗雷后，使其冲击力降低所示比例，持续1.2秒。同类削冲取最强、各自计时；同名弱者不续时。不减伤，不保证等比例减距或免打断。","iconGuid":"562a0fa5-7de3-531f-8628-8bfa77285ec1","families":["control.consumed-thunder-impulse"],"mechanism":{"kind":"affix","parameters":{"stat":"contactStatusStrength","operation":"increased","scopeByKind":{"weapon":"equipment"},"sourceDomain":{"effectiveUsage":"player","modules":["returning-sword"],"boards":[],"ownerChain":["atlas-s12"],"purePresentation":false,"ordinaryAvailability":"module-gated","moduleEvidence":"金笼焰专属耗雷后缀；装备准备核验本器身份、真实词值与耗雷工序。"},"eligibility":{"id":"affix.roll.jinlong-discharged-impact","name":"卸振","systems":["returning-sword"],"introducedInPoolVersion":3,"definitionVersion":1,"balanceVersion":1,"comparableRuleVersion":1,"ownerEquipmentId":"atlas-s12","slot":"suffix","unit":"percent","stat":"contactStatusStrength","operation":"increased","visualSignal":"rune","consumer":{"capability":"sword-tuning","version":4},"recordPolicy":"higher","allowedKinds":["weapon"],"poolKinds":["weapon"],"poolFamilies":["returning-melee"],"scopeByKind":{"weapon":"equipment"},"minRarity":2,"minimumItemLevel":1,"selectionWeight":0.45,"budgetCost":10,"maximumEffectiveValue":0.18,"conflicts":[],"contactStatus":{"statusId":"jinlong-discharged-impact","trigger":"consumed-status","consumedStatusId":"thunder-mark"}}}},"strength":[{"field":"value","label":"敌人冲击力降低比例","formula":{"kind":"affix-range","definitionId":"affix.roll.jinlong-discharged-impact","baseValue":0.08,"valuePerTier":0.006,"operation":"increased","unit":"降低比例（0.08表示冲击力乘0.92）","levels":{"min":1,"max":100,"kind":"integer"}}}],"relations":{"defaultWeight":0,"familyRules":[],"targetOverrides":[{"targetId":"effect.affix.jinlong-lattice-guard","weight":0.15,"reason":"卸振削仍活敌人冲击，束焰护保护主人，可读同次真耗雷；没有第二次消印、伤害包或费用。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.tinglv-thunder-guard","weight":0,"reason":"金笼焰卸振是另一把剑的消费结果，不是霆律的消费依据。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.jinlong-charge-shed","weight":0,"reason":"卸振确认本剑耗敌雷后削敌冲击，敛电是主人受雷被动；两项既不共用受体，也不互为触发。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s12.continuous-returning-strike","weight":0.35,"reason":"只有本件确认接触能带出卸振；这是低权护线选项，裸剑不因固有主击自动取得后缀。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s12.metal-lattice-flame","weight":1,"reason":"金栅束焰实际耗雷是直接触发条件；原增伤仍属于同次接触，卸振不另开伤害包。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s12.seek-marked-first","weight":0.55,"reason":"寻雷提高遇到条件目标的机会，不能保证飞剑抵达时雷痕尚未被别剑消费。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s12.ignite-ember-mark","weight":0,"reason":"后段点燃留下的是灼痕，不是雷痕消费；不能二次触发卸振或强化其比例。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s12.source-status-damage","weight":0,"reason":"卸振没有伤害tick，既不受来源状态伤害倍率影响，也不延长灼痕。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s12.intrinsic-element-infusion","weight":0,"reason":"金火分量不改变卸振词值；不因同器子节点数多重复提高偏好。"},{"targetId":"effect.status.thunder-mark","weight":0.6,"reason":"有效雷痕是金栅束焰的必要前置；卸振本身不刻雷，已耗掉的灵抗减益也不保留。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s23.conductive-thunder-mark","weight":0.35,"reason":"鎏炎汽脉同击后段耗火而不耗雷，可留雷给金笼焰；供雷不直接削低敌人的冲击力。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s24.conductive-thunder-mark","weight":0.45,"reason":"汽焰锁刻雷不要求前段破膜成功；卸振仍需金笼焰另行击伤并真耗这枚雷。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s26.conductive-thunder-mark","weight":0.45,"reason":"沸潮封刃实扣血后独立留雷，无膜也可供应；汽压破膜本身不算耗雷。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s28.conductive-thunder-mark","weight":0.35,"reason":"五炁归炉后段淬回不消雷，可供后续束焰；其他元素工序不重复增加卸振偏好。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s29.conductive-thunder-mark","weight":0.55,"reason":"逐电留雷而不自耗，能稳定提供候选前置；其短控不提高卸振降低比例。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s32.conductive-thunder-mark","weight":0.3,"reason":"藏夜收割后续雷可供应金笼焰，也会与自身下一次收割竞争；同枚雷不能保证被两剑消费。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s02.marked-vibration-cut","weight":0.05,"reason":"鸣律振切与束焰竞争同枚雷；允许低权共存，不借此授予鸣律的逆律或断拍。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s30.marked-vibration-cut","weight":0.05,"reason":"霆律振切也是耗雷者；同枚旧雷只归一个成功消费者，不能把它当成供雷工序。"},{"targetId":"effect.atlas-s32.revealed-target-harvest","weight":0.05,"reason":"藏夜收割这一步只消费旧雷，后道刻雷才是供应；两步不能合成虚假的双重收益。"},{"targetId":"effect.status.jinlong-discharged-impact","weight":1,"reason":"真实卸振词值只生成一份私有状态；状态不制造新词值、雷印或额外接触。"},{"targetId":"effect.thunder-spell.elemental-cast","weight":0,"reason":"未启用的雷霆术法原型不提高普通金笼焰的获取偏好，也不因此扩大实验载体随机资格。"},{"targetId":"effect.status.ember-mark","weight":0,"reason":"卸振只认雷痕的实际消费；灼痕存续不提高此词的概率、强度或持续时间。"},{"targetId":"effect.status.elemental-frost-bind","weight":0,"reason":"消水膜不是耗雷，金水视觉联想不能替代明确的金栅束焰触发条件。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.feichao-pressure-release","weight":0,"reason":"泄压与这项效果属于显式削冲组，各自计时后只取抗性折算最强；不叠乘、不借另一物件消膜凭据。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.xiangfeng-root-disarm","weight":0,"reason":"束械逐向复核：卸振保留自身触发、1.2秒与18%帽，和束械同属削冲组，重叠只取抗性后的最强，不奖励额外乘层。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.duanshuang-gap-impulse","weight":0,"reason":"同类削冲取抗性后的最强，保留各自时钟；多个同组词不叠加降低量。"}]},"designNotes":["卸振与敛震都需要本剑实际耗雷；仅刻雷或别剑消耗不触发。同组削冲只取抗性衰减后的最强一项，各自计时，不再异名乘算。","先算金栅束焰同击增伤，实扣气血后成功移除雷痕，点燃独立留灼痕，最后按成功消费凭据施加卸振；不再消印或收一次接触费。","无雷、过期雷、只有灼痕、零伤、无敌、只撞盾、致死接触、非接触和伤害tick不触发；真实零伤接触声音保持原规则。","物等中点m(L)=0.08+0.0006(L−1)，沿原affixLevelRange及roundedQualityValue；L100上界16.728%低于18%执行帽，非法输入拒绝而非夹取。","实际词值x直接给modifierStrength，从中性倍率1向端点0插值得1−x，不再乘一次18%上限。固定1.2秒、同名取强，弱来源不续时。","冲击力进入原击退公式；12%削冲不等于12%减距。staggered/staggerSeconds只控制踉跄表现，不改变真实动作中断规则。","不增加标准木桩DPS或10秒无条件承伤主值，不增加世界VFX、计时器、状态层数或每帧关系扫描。"],"placement":{"contentPackId":"base-returning-sword","categoryPath":["weapons","atlas-s12","effects","attributes"],"scope":"exclusive","owner":{"kind":"weapon","id":"atlas-s12","name":"金笼焰"}},"provenance":{"sourcePaths":["assets/packs/content/base-returning-sword/weapons/atlas-s12/effects/attributes/affix.jinlong-discharged-impact/effect.pack.ts","assets/packs/content/base-returning-sword/weapons/atlas-s12/effects/attributes/affix.jinlong-discharged-impact/item-affix.pack.ts","src/weapon-arsenal/contact-status-affix.ts","src/combat/sword-contact-status.ts","src/combat/impact.ts","docs/design/proposals/FOUR-SWORD-CONTROL-AND-WARD-SUFFIX-PLAN.md"],"legacyNodeIds":[]}}}
